The '''''Flame of Sinthara''''' was a [[cathedral ship]] in service to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]]. In [[10,966 BBY]], the ''Flame of Sinthara'' participated in the [[Battle of Uquine]] against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]&ndash;[[Renunciates|Renunciate]] alliance. During the battle, the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was boarded by a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who captured [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex XIX]] at the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].

==Description==
The ''Flame of Sinthara'' was a [[cathedral ship]] with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="EGW" />

==History==
In [[10,966 BBY]], the ''Flame of Sinthara'' traveled through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uquine/Legends|Uquine]] with [[Contispex XIX]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Pius Dea]]&ndash;controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], on board. The ''Flame of Sinthara'' and the Pius Dea [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] were looking to destroy the [[Renunciates]], a faction that had abandoned ideals from the Pius Dea religion and were plotting against them with the help of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] people, and the forces of the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="EGW" />

Unbeknownst to the Pius Dea Republic, the Renunciates had baited them to Uquine. When the cathedral [[Starship/Legends|ships]] arrived at Uquine, they found themselves under [[Battle of Uquine|attack]] from the combined forces from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&ndash;Renunciate alliance. During the battle, a team of Jedi boarded the ''Flame of Sinthara'' and made their way to the warship's bridge, where they captured Chancellor Contispex XIX. With Contispex's capture, the Pius Dea rule of the Galactic Republic came to an end.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Flame of Sinthara'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EGW" />
